mainEntity.name: When should drywall and finish work happen in a room addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should start drywall and finish work after the room addition framing, insulation, and mechanical rough-ins are complete. The drywall crew can then hang, tape, mud, sand, and prepare the space for paint or texture without having to redo finished surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall and finish work usually starts after framing, insulation, and electrical/HVAC/plumbing rough-ins are done. That sequence helps avoid damage and keeps the finish smooth and ready for paint.
